linked_prs.title: Support inference with vLLM-Ascend
linked_prs.body:
# What does this PR do?
Support inference with vLLM-Ascend

Fixes #7447 

## Implementation details
For applications that start vLLM GPU and NPU programs in subprocess mode, you need to use spawn to pull the subprocess. For such application code, you need to use freeze_support to protect recursive imports and pull subprocesses. Other information can see in [url](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.7.3/design/multiprocessing.html).

## Before submitting

- [*] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [*] Did you write any new necessary tests?

I verified with two NPU cards, it okay, as following:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0740f21f-4c4b-4500-8e92-6c43934d17a7)
